_about: Start work / Coding / Design / Clock out modes. To use it: python3 launcher.py config.modes.json
_format: open is a list opened in order (app = app name in /Applications, url = default browser), close lists app names to quit, farewell is the text shown on the confetti screen.
_new_option: Opens a new window even if the app is already running (for filming). Terminal leaves running windows alone and only opens a new one; with command it runs that in the new window. Other apps get ⌘N, which needs Accessibility permission. Don't use it for Notion, Figma or Teams — ⌘N creates a new document there.
_file_option: Opens this file in that app. A new window appears without any permission, and the content shows on screen.
_confetti_text: farewell is the big text, farewell_sub the small text below it. Leave out farewell_sub and it shows 'Great work today'.
_chrome_warning: Clock out quits Chrome. Your open tabs close with it, so remove "Google Chrome" from the close list if that bothers you. The confetti also uses Chrome, so Chrome comes back right after as the single confetti window.
_never_close_terminal: If the launcher runs in Terminal, closing Terminal makes Clock out kill the launcher itself.
